title: Rivet check
description: Rivet diagnostics for a project (rivet-check from @rivetjs/language-core): compiler errors of both targets, serializability, route links. Routed apps run rivet sync first.

tsConfig.description: tsconfig file(s) to check, relative to the project. Default tsconfig.json.

types.description: Type-aware checks (RV2101 serializability, RV3101 route links).

manifest.description: Check .rivet/editor.json (RV7101 / RV7102). Default: routed apps only.

sync.description: Run rivet sync first. Default: routed apps only.
